items.a: Sri Lankan candidates seeking legitimate, skilled employment opportunities in Europe who are committed to undertaking professional training, language development, and legal document verification.
We work with employers and authorized mobility partners across Western and Central Europe, including Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Poland, Romania, and other EU destination countries.
Our core academies cover Commercial Drivers (C/CE), Hospitality & Culinary, Care & Healthcare Support, Logistics & Warehouse, and Skilled Trades (Welders, Electricians, Mechanics, Construction).

items.q: Do I need prior European language knowledge?
items.a: No prior European language is strictly required to register. SLEDMC Academy provides foundational and workplace-specific language training as part of your preparation pathway.

items.q: How does the Professional Driver programme work?
items.a: Drivers with valid heavy vehicle licenses (C/CE) undergo EU road environment training, tachograph regulation study, cargo securing instruction, and Code 95/CQC qualification pathways through authorized partner institutions.

items.q: Does SLEDMC guarantee employment or visas?
items.a: No. SLEDMC does not promise or guarantee visas or employment. All employment decisions depend on direct employer selection, and visa issuance is strictly governed by destination government immigration authorities.

items.q: What documents are required to get started?
items.a: To register, candidates need a valid passport, educational/trade certificates, detailed work experience proof, police clearance (or application), and driving licence (for driver roles).

items.q: How long does the preparation process take?
items.a: Preparation duration varies by sector and candidate readiness, typically ranging from 8 weeks to 4 months including language modules, skills training, and document legalization.
